name: Confront Lorthuna
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.

I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Elaadrin and help them stop Lorthuna.

Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, champion.
narrative.objectives: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with High Priestess Lorthuna.
narrative.offerRewardText: I sent a few of our remaining mages to ensure that Valennia and her forces were able to escape as well. She should be resting at High Elder Shadowsong's residence now.Ansirem had to return to Azeroth, but he and I discussed the next steps for the High Order before he departed. We survived the day, but Zephras is dangerously vulnerable now and we must make plans for what is to come.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 12 to 13, 2,555 XP in all.

quests.name: Confront Lorthuna
quests.objectiveText: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with High Priestess Lorthuna.

quests.name: The Fate of Zephras
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

quests.name: What Comes Next
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.

quests.name: The Magical City of Dalaran
quests.objectiveText: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Dalaran City and speak with Danaaris Stargale when you arrive.

quests.name: Welcome to Azeroth
quests.objectiveText: Take the Skyborne Portal to Stormwind and report to Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.

quests.name: Exploring the Alliance
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Randal Emerson in Stormwind Keep to receive further instructions.
